scoring_justification: Lattice constant is recomputed from submitted atomic positions; remaining properties are compared to paper-reported gold because full DFT recompute is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Overall tier is set to recompute due to geometry check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported lattice constants (a=3.62, 3.76 Å) and atomic element counts for geometry validation
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed directly from the paper's published values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the authentic reported lattice parameters and elemental composition of the stable structures.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported phonon stability verdict and minimum frequencies (both stable, >0 cm⁻¹)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed from the paper's conclusion that B2N4-I and B3N3-I are dynamically stable with no soft modes
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's main stability claims.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported mechanical properties (Young's moduli, intrinsic strengths, fracture strains) from Table 2
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the measured quantities the reproduction must align with.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported band gap of B3N3-I at zero strain (0.06 eV) and direct-to-indirect transition strain (5%)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the electronic benchmark values.

B2N4-I.atomic_positions: list of objects with element (string) and x,y,z (float) in fractional coordinates

B3N3-I.atomic_positions: list of objects with element (string) and x,y,z (float) in fractional coordinates

outputs.description: Optimized geometries and total energies of B2N4-I and B3N3-I, compared to paper-reported reference values within tolerances.
Dynamical stability verdict and minimum phonon frequency; stability requires true and frequency > -0.5 cm⁻¹.

B2N4-I.Young_modulus_2D: object with biaxial, x_axial, y_axial (float N/m)
B2N4-I.intrinsic_strength: object with biaxial, x_axial, y_axial (float GPa)
B2N4-I.fracture_strain: object with biaxial, x_axial, y_axial (float, decimal)

outputs.description: Mechanical properties and band gap evolution; compared to paper-reported values within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare lattice constants, bond lengths, and total energy from structures_optimized.json to paper reference values within tolerances. For phonon_stability.json, it checks that dynamically_stable is true and min_phonon_frequency > -0.5 cm⁻¹. For mechanical_and_band_gap.json, 2D Young's moduli, intrinsic strengths, fracture strains, and band gaps are compared within tolerances; the direct-to-indirect transition strain must lie between 4% and 6%.
